name: loopboard-todo
description: Less prompting. No babysitting. More building. — the missing UI for Claude Code loops: your TODO.md as a live board your agents groom, build, and deliver from.

loopBoard.defaultWorkerModel.markdownDescription: The model that owns (works) tasks with no explicit `model:` field.

loopBoard.defaultGroomerModel.markdownDescription: The model that grooms tasks/drafts with no explicit `groomer:` field.

loopBoard.models.opus.enabled.description: Show the Opus slot in the Loops overview and the board's model selects.

loopBoard.models.opus.model.markdownDescription: Custom `--model` string spawned for the Opus slot (e.g. `opus[1m]`). Empty = `opus`. Invalid strings are ignored.

loopBoard.models.opus.effort.markdownDescription: Grooming-subagent reasoning-effort ceiling for the Opus slot (Rule 14 in `LOOP.md`) — the loop chooses low..this ceiling by story complexity, reserving xhigh/max for when the ceiling allows it and the story explicitly asks for deep reasoning.

loopBoard.models.sonnet.enabled.description: Show the Sonnet slot in the Loops overview and the board's model selects.

loopBoard.models.sonnet.model.markdownDescription: Custom `--model` string spawned for the Sonnet slot (e.g. `sonnet[1m]`). Empty = `sonnet`. Invalid strings are ignored.

loopBoard.models.sonnet.effort.markdownDescription: Grooming-subagent reasoning-effort ceiling for the Sonnet slot (Rule 14 in `LOOP.md`) — the loop chooses low..this ceiling by story complexity, reserving xhigh/max for when the ceiling allows it and the story explicitly asks for deep reasoning.

loopBoard.models.fable.enabled.description: Show the Fable slot in the Loops overview and the board's model selects.

loopBoard.models.fable.model.markdownDescription: Custom `--model` string spawned for the Fable slot. Empty = `fable`. Invalid strings are ignored.

loopBoard.models.fable.effort.markdownDescription: Grooming-subagent reasoning-effort ceiling for the Fable slot (Rule 14 in `LOOP.md`) — the loop chooses low..this ceiling by story complexity, reserving xhigh/max for when the ceiling allows it and the story explicitly asks for deep reasoning.

loopBoard.autoRecycle.description: When a model finishes a task, restart its loop terminal (close it and open a new one) so the next task starts fresh. The heavier of the two fresh-context options. Off by default; restart manually with ♻.

loopBoard.clearSessionAfterTask.description: When a model finishes a task, send /clear to its loop terminal so the next task starts fresh. Same result as Auto Recycle but lighter: the terminal keeps running, only the conversation is cleared. Off by default. Ignored when Auto Recycle is on (a restart already clears everything).

loopBoard.maxAttachmentSizeMB.markdownDescription: Maximum size (MB) for an image attached to a task (drag-drop, paste, or the picker). Attachments are staged under `.loopboard/cache/` and cleaned up on acceptance.

loopBoard.permissionMode.markdownDescription: `--permission-mode` passed to the `claude` CLI when spawning a loop terminal.
